own_solution.law: Using K = p²/(2m) and λ = h/p gives λ = hc/√(2mc²K). Convert mc² to 511000 eV; for K = 150 eV, λ = 0.10015 nm = 100.15 pm. An additional energy q before determination replaces K by 150 eV + q.
assumptions: Use the explicitly stated nonrelativistic model.
Evaluate the wavelength at the specified determination time.
The separate apparatus does not transfer energy or momentum to the electron.
